title: Structured-polar depth-slot utilization corrective attribution
purpose: Correct the V1 attribution by testing whether its high top16 oracle recall actually uses the second radial-depth slot required by the method.

approval.scope: One immutable read-only C07-C08 depth-slot provenance correction over the sealed capacity and V1 attribution; zero training, inference, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User delegated best-method decisions and continuous execution; V1 omitted the semantic depth-slot utilization gate.

raw_sources: Sealed Observable Teacher V2 C07-C08 targets.

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Use all sealed C07-C08 targets and top16 candidates once. Replay deterministic all-candidate matching and retain prediction depth-slot provenance for every matched target; no resampling or selection.

teacher.source: Observable Teacher V2 plus deterministic same-bin ascending-radius slot semantics.
teacher.student_input: No student execution; sealed predictions only.

split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: None; all top16 and sealed 0.95 provenance only.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Only sealed C07-C08 Teacher, capacity and V1 attribution hashes are bound.

methods.main: Count top16 and sealed selected candidates by predicted depth slot; retain predicted slot for every typed 4m oracle match; measure second-depth targets and same-bin near/far pairs jointly matched by distinct predicted slots.
methods.baseline: V1 typed oracle recall 0.619-0.685 and V1 decision FROZEN_GEOMETRY_OBJECTNESS_REFIT_REQUIRED.
methods.fallback: If every seed does not use slot1 for at least one second-depth target and one jointly covered pair, V1 objectness-only decision is superseded and the structured multi-depth route stops.

acceptance.population: Exactly 45942 observations, 33145 targets, 79 same-bin second-depth targets and three archives.
acceptance.semantic_gate: Every seed must use a predicted slot1 candidate for at least one second-depth target and jointly cover at least one same-bin near/far pair with distinct predicted slots before objectness-only refit is admissible.
acceptance.system: Zero optimizer/inference/threshold selection/forbidden reads; exact V1/source replay and complete seal.

failure_policy: Any join, slot provenance, matching or population ambiguity fails closed; do not modify V1 or capacity evidence.
retention: Retain summary, CSV, PNG/PDF/SVG/source, logs and seal.
